proof_boundaries: Account groups are explicit counterfactual assignments; public data does not identify observed rider histories or trajectories.
Historical January2024 real durations are priced using current captured policies; these are not claimed historical bills.
Pretax classic-bike base transportation costs only; taxes, parking, penalties and unrelated adjustments are not observed.
Local source ZIP/CSV consistency and recorded official URL are verified; no new network request or independent publisher authentication was performed.
Calculator/agent verifier values were not used to derive expected results.
Final response comparisons use the supplied two genuine runs only; no statistical reliability claim is inferred.
